name: 59405 · Great Falls, MT
findings: ZIP 59405 (Great Falls) has 116 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 59405 (Great Falls) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 59405 (Great Falls) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 74% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
